title.narrative: Towards Malaria Elimination: Expanding Test, Track and Treat in Mining Areas - Suriname (01-Apr-2021-31-Mar-2024)

description.narrative: Suriname, Malaria, Ministry of Health, Welfare and Labour (MOH)This program has the following goals: Contain imported malaria and local outbreaks and prevent the re-introduction of Malaria in Suriname while moving towards elimination. The objectives of this program are: Treat freely 95% of malaria cases. Track and report 90% of the cases with diagnosis. Achieve parasitology confirmation of all cases. Achieve more than 90% coverage of LLIN's in selected high risk and vulnerable population. Increase the percentage of Malaria knowledge
